enunciado: Write recursively: digitSum(n), isPalindrome(s, i, j) comparing the ends of the string, and binary(n) which prints n in base 2. Test them with 9045, "reconocer", "recursion" and 37.
objetivos: Apply recursion to numbers and strings
Print in the right order by using the unwinding of the recursion
pistas: A string is a palindrome if the ends match and the inside is one too.
In binary, print the bit AFTER the recursive call.
